title: patch_file CRLF failure on signals JSON during fix_signal mark phase
description: patch_file returned 'error applying hunk #1' when attempting to add picked_up_at and fix_branch to .moeb/signals/fc155279-e782-4028-89a8-bf3c94fdb50f.signals.json. A write_file fallback was required. This is the same CRLF/context-line mismatch root cause as the signal being processed (a1b2c3d4-0001-4000-8000-000000000001), confirming the issue remains present and affects all harness JSON files on Windows.
proposed_resolution: The root cause is tracked in signal a1b2c3d4-0001-4000-8000-000000000001 (fix patch_file hunk relocation for CRLF files). Resolve that signal to eliminate this recurring fallback pattern.

title: moeb-tool-origin rubric fail: ToolSearch and Read used without MissingMoebTool signals
description: ToolSearch was used twice (to load mcp__moeb__fix_signal schema and file/VCS tool schemas) and Read was used once (to read the oversized fix_signal tool output from the harness overflow file). No MissingMoebTool signals were written during this run for these external tool uses. The moeb-tool-origin rubric failed as a result.
proposed_resolution: The fix_signal skill should include explicit MissingMoebTool signal templates at the top of Phase 1 covering the two mandatory bootstrap tools (ToolSearch for deferred schema loading, Read for overflow result files), so agents buffer them before proceeding to the scan phase.

title: fix_signal.skill.md missing bootstrap MissingMoebTool signal instructions
description: The fix_signal skill does not instruct the agent to write MissingMoebTool signals for the bootstrap tools (ToolSearch, Read) that are structurally required before the moeb tool registry is accessible. Every fix_signal invocation will fail moeb-tool-origin because these tools are used before any skill instruction is encountered.
proposed_resolution: Add a Bootstrap phase (Phase 0) to fix_signal.skill.md that pre-empts the Tool Origin Policy disclaimer with explicit MissingMoebTool signal templates for ToolSearch and Read, and instructs the agent to write them to a staging buffer before the first moeb tool call.

title: Missing moeb tool: overflow result reader for fix_signal output
description: The fix_signal tool output exceeds the MCP result size limit, causing the harness to save it to a local file. Reading this file requires the external Claude Code Read tool. No moeb tool exists to retrieve harness-saved overflow result artifacts. This forces a moeb-tool-origin failure on every fix_signal invocation.
proposed_resolution: Run moeb spec to introduce a moeb read_overflow_result tool (or extend read_file to accept harness overflow paths), or reduce fix_signal output size so results fit within MCP limits.
